scope: Controlled races hold individual mock identity responses; real-editor runs cover overlapping choices without injecting transport delays.
Explicit ports retain their existing per-call routing behavior. A port can change owners after verification; identity shape is not authentication.
Only pending explicit-selection guards are added; they are removed on completion, failure or cancellation. Long-lived selection/context maps are unchanged.
baselineNote: The final fifteen-check suite was rerun against an isolated checkout of the exact preceding server. It supersedes the initial eleven-check run, whose lost-selection case encountered a fixture JSON parse error before its final assertions; the final helper accepts plain MCP errors and directly verifies that the selection was cleared.
